village.definition: A small group of homes in the countryside, smaller than a town.
village.example: The sea is far from our village.

villages.definition: small groups of houses in the countryside, smaller than a town.
villages.example: The road follows the coast past little fishing villages.

visit.definition: to go and see a place or person for a while.
visit.example: Sami would love to visit the zoo.

visited.definition: went and saw a place or person for a while.
visited.example: Half the class visited the court.

visiting.definition: going to see a place or person for a while.
visiting.example: Amal led the tour for the visiting parents.

visitor.definition: a person who is visiting a place for a short time.
visitor.example: Oh no, the visitor already left!

visitors.definition: people who are visiting a place for a short time.
visitors.example: We will read, write, and perform for the visitors.

voices.definition: the sounds people make with their mouths when they speak or sing.
voices.example: Quiet voices keep the library calm for readers.

volcanoes.definition: mountains with an opening that can shoot out hot, melted rock.
volcanoes.example: My favourite lesson this week was about volcanoes.

waiting.definition: staying in a place until something happens or someone arrives.
waiting.example: Theo, your father is waiting outside!

walked.definition: moved along on foot at a normal, steady speed.
walked.example: We walked past the little shop.

walking.definition: moving along on foot, one step after another.
walking.example: Do you like walking in the rain?

walks.definition: moves along on foot, one step after another.
walks.example: Amal walks to school with Nora.

wall.definition: an upright structure, often of brick or stone, that encloses a space.
wall.example: The old wall was white and clean.

wallet.definition: a small, folding case used for carrying money and cards.
wallet.example: Rami the police officer thanked the honest boy who returned the wallet.

want.definition: to wish for or desire something quite strongly.
want.example: What do you want to become, Adam?

wanted.definition: wished for or desired something, hoping it would happen.
wanted.example: Mina wanted just a bit more juice.

wants.definition: wishes for or desires something, hoping it will happen.
wants.example: Amal wants to sell her old books.

ward.definition: a room or section of a hospital where patients stay.
ward.example: Two nurses walked quietly through the ward.

warm.definition: having a comfortable, fairly high temperature; not hot or cold.
warm.example: What a warm spring this has been!

watch.definition: to look at something that is happening for a while.
watch.example: Watch out, that pin is sharp!

watched.definition: looked at something that was happening, for a while.
watched.example: Leo watched the storm from his window.

watered.definition: gave water to a plant to help it grow.
watered.example: Nora laughed until her eyes watered.

waters.definition: gives water to plants to help them grow well.
waters.example: Who waters the garden during the holidays?

waved.definition: moved a hand from side to side as a greeting.
waved.example: Nora waved back at her mother.

waves.definition: moving ridges of water on the surface of the sea.
waves.example: Is that foam from the waves?

way.definition: a route you take to get from one place to another.
way.example: He is glancing this way again!

ways.definition: different manners or methods of doing or seeing something.
ways.example: I think Amal and Nora are similar in many ways.

weakest.definition: having the least strength or skill of all.
weakest.example: I gave an honest answer about my weakest showcase page.

weather.definition: What the sky and air are like today.
weather.example: Are your feet cold in this weather?

wedding.definition: the ceremony where two people get married to each other.
wedding.example: My aunt's wedding was in February last year.

weekend.definition: Saturday and Sunday, the two days at the end of the week.
weekend.example: Nora, tell me about your weekend!

weight.definition: How heavy something is when you put it on the scales.
weight.example: The scales show the weight of the flour.

welcome.definition: gladly accepted, and invited warmly to come somewhere.
welcome.example: Hello, everyone, welcome to our class!

went.definition: moved from one place, level or state to another.
went.example: That car went by so fast!

whenever.definition: at any time that something happens, every single time.
whenever.example: The wall shakes whenever the wind blows.

whole.definition: all of something; complete, with nothing missing at all.
whole.example: Did you actually see the whole film?

win.definition: to come first or succeed in a game or contest.
win.example: Did your group win the competition?

wind.definition: moving air that you can feel blowing outside.

windows.definition: openings in a wall, covered with glass, that let in light.
windows.example: Karim is able to clean the highest windows safely.

winds.definition: movements of moving air that you can feel outside.
winds.example: A narrow track winds up the side of the mountain.

winning.definition: coming first or succeeding in a game or contest.
winning.example: Sami kept smiling after winning the race.

wish.definition: to want something very much, especially something that may not happen.
wish.example: Nora, close your eyes and make a wish!

woke.definition: stopped sleeping and became awake, opening your eyes.
woke.example: Amal said, "The sun woke me up early."

won.definition: came first or succeeded in a game or contest.

wonder.definition: to want to know something, and think curiously about it.
wonder.example: I wonder whether it will rain today.

wood.definition: the hard material that the trunk and branches of a tree are made of.
wood.example: I smoothed the rough wood with a piece of sandpaper.

wooden.definition: made from the hard material that trees are made of.
wooden.example: We built a wooden support for the wall.

words.definition: units of language, spoken or written, that each have their own meaning.
words.example: The list had thirty words on it.

workers.definition: people who do a job, often using their hands or skills.
workers.example: Workers paved the new car park on Monday.

works.definition: has a paid job at a particular place, such as a hospital.
works.example: Amal's mum works at the hospital.

world.definition: the Earth, and everyone and everything that lives on it.
world.example: Which mountain is the highest in the world?

worry.definition: to feel anxious or troubled about something that might happen.
worry.example: Nora, do not worry, that is not a problem!

wrapped.definition: covered something by folding material carefully around it.
wrapped.example: The shopkeeper wrapped each item with care.

writes.definition: puts words down on paper using a pen or pencil.
writes.example: A teacher reads each draft and writes one helpful target.

writing.definition: putting words down on paper using a pen or pencil.
writing.example: Sami, stop thinking and start writing!

written.definition: put down in words on paper, rather than spoken.
written.example: What is written upon this label, Amal?

wrong.definition: not correct, or not the right thing to do.
wrong.example: Who pointed at the wrong answer?

wrongly.definition: in a way that is not correct or right.
wrongly.example: Nora said, "I spelt million wrongly on my first try."

wrote.definition: put words down on paper using a pen or pencil.
wrote.example: Sami wrote eighty on the board.

year.definition: a period of twelve months, from one date to the same date the next.
year.example: How many months are in a year?

years.definition: periods of twelve months, each one following after the last.
years.example: The road was paved a few years ago.

young.definition: having lived for only a short time; not old.
young.example: Grandma Hana was once a young girl herself.

younger.definition: less old than someone else; not as old.
younger.example: Amal likes to help the younger students.

zeros.definition: the number nought, written to show there is nothing there.
zeros.example: How many zeros does one million have?

zoo.definition: a place where wild animals are kept for people to see.
zoo.example: Sami would love to visit the zoo.
